semanticAndStyleSelfReview.method: Owner AI translated Japanese-only source directly, compared every section/lesson/question including all four option-specific rationales, then reviewed own Nepali as connected teaching prose. No target locale was used as source or cross-review input.
checks: Respectful तपाईं and honorific verbs; self-reference म, no invented gender, age or kinship.
Exact Haruko-san versus Haruko-chan and surname versus given-name learning contrasts retained.
Consent for cleaning, moving private possessions, photography and sharing information with each recipient kept distinct.
Confirmed facts, unconfirmed deadlines, planned checks and completed actions kept distinct; no fabricated times or guarantees.
Infection symptoms and trigger-to-medical-professional reporting retained explicitly; suspected swallowing trouble is directed to nurse/ST without independent training or diagnosis.
Body mechanics retains individual plan, condition, equipment instructions, staffing, training and limits on manual lifting.
Every question preserves four separate option-specific reasons; repeated effective readings are retained rather than omitted as redundant.
Each Japanese paragraph has one complete Nepali counterpart in source order; no summary substitution.

correctionsBeforeAtomicOutput.change: Used शेल्फ for 棚 rather than drawer wording, preserving the source furniture meaning.
ST rendered वाक् तथा श्रवण थेरापिस्ट, preserving a therapist role rather than implying a physician.
Replaced an awkward avoid-construction with natural टाढा रहन्छौँ; retained the action and negation.
